The remaining foreign earnings were repatriated in 2016, reducing the deferred tax liabilities to zero at december 31, 2016. As of december 31, 2017 we had a $ 2.0 billion multi-year credit facility, which expires in november 2022. The credit facility has been established with a diverse syndicate of banks.
